mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over two consecutive quarters signals a tightening monetary regime, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of quarters when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of quarters when GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 5-day forward returns in more than 70% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous fall in PAYEMS and a rise in UNRATE above 0.3 percentage points within one month indicates labor market tightening with stagnant payroll growth, which compresses profit margins and signals negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS decreases month-over-month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) in periods where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive decline in INDPRO below -1% signals a contraction in industrial production, reflecting weakening business activity and reduced earnings potential, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of episodes when INDPRO < -1% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in both HOUST and RSAFS above their respective 12-month moving averages signals increased housing and retail demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month drop in FEDFUNDS below 0.25% during a period of negative GDP growth signals an emergency easing, which supports risk assets and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops > 0.25pp AND GDPC1 YoY < 0% in same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10) in months meeting both trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent UNRATE below 3.5% for four consecutive months signals a slack labor market, which reduces wage inflation and supports corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where UNRATE < 3.5% for four consecutive months.
